plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Project onboarding: a natural interview with a coverage tracker that turns an app idea or an existing codebase into a full SOW, then hands off to design and build.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Premium web and app design: brief interview, taste picker, token system, prototype, production build and screenshot verification.

plugins.name: napkin
plugins.description: Lazy senior architect mode, always on: the fewest components that meet the real requirements, sized for today's scale and written down with when to revisit.

plugins.name: nitpick
plugins.description: Strict code review from an opinionated senior dev who nitpicks everything: readable names, clean organization, no repetition, reuse of existing helpers, mainstream libraries over niche ones.

plugins.name: pager
plugins.description: Lazy senior DevOps mode, always on: the fewest moving parts that fully solve the infrastructure task, with a verified rollout and a way back.
